lesson.hot_air_balloon.title: Hot Air Balloon
lesson.hot_air_balloon.summary: Build a floating balloon from one big shape, simple panel lines and a basket, then explore bold color combinations.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.step.envelope: Begin with one tall, rounded balloon shape. Let it feel wide in the middle and gently narrow near the bottom.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.help.envelope: Think of a giant upside-down raindrop with a soft rounded top.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.step.panels: Add two curved panel lines from near the top toward the narrow bottom. They help the balloon feel three-dimensional.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.help.panels: Keep the two lines balanced around the center, but they do not need to be perfectly identical.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.step.basket: Connect the balloon to a small basket with two ropes, then close the basket shape underneath.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.help.basket: Leave a little air between the balloon and basket so the ropes are easy to see.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.step.sky_details: Add a couple of soft cloud marks around your balloon. You can keep them small so the balloon stays the star.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.help.sky_details: Clouds can be loose curves—there is no single correct cloud shape.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.complete.drawing: Your balloon is ready for a colorful flight.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.coloring.center: Choose a color for the center panel first. Bright, calm, surprising—your choice.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.coloring.sides: Now fill both side panels. They can match each other or contrast with the center.
lesson.hot_air_balloon.coloring.basket: Finish the prepared regions by coloring the basket.
